title: Colonization of Government Lands Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: Colonization of Government Lands Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 2011
ACT II OF 2011
COLONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT LANDS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act to amend the Colonization of Government
Lands Act, 1912.
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV
2nd March, 2011]
No.PAS/Legis-B-20/2010, dated 22-2-2011.---The Colonization of Government
Lands (Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 15th November, 2010 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 8th February, 2011 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.--Whereas it is expedient
to amend the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Colonization of
Government Lands (Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be
deemed to have taken effect on and from 10th day of October, 2010.

[Gazette of Sindh,

No.PAS/Legis-B-20/2010, dated 22-2-2011.---The Colonization of Government
Lands (Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 15th November, 2010 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 8th February, 2011 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.--Whereas it is expedient
to amend the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
2. Amendment of section 10 of Act V of 1912.---In
the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912, in section 10, in subsection
(5), in the proviso, the full stop at the end shall be replaced by a colon and
thereafter the following proviso shall be added:-
"Provided further that the Chief
Minister may extend the period of completion of projects in respect of land
granted for education and health purposes in the cases where the delay in
completion of project is not on account of any negligence on the part of
grantee.".
